model.assumptions: niche agent-API; bot 5-min poller = 8,640 calls/mo; human 100-200 calls/mo; elastic e=1.2 (free CoinGecko/self-serve alternatives) and inelastic e=0.8 swept; funnel 20-200 bots + 10-120 humans across pessimistic/base/optimistic
model.evidence: scratch/arb/pricing-model.txt (inelastic artifact: linear fixed-volume model) + scratch/arb/pricing-model2.txt (elastic: revenue strictly decreasing in price $0.001->$0.03 in BOTH e=1.2 and e=0.8; all monthly tariffs underperform pure per-call at floor)
model.flatMaximum: revenue gap $0.002->$0.003 is small in every scenario while unit margin is 50% higher and further above settle variance: $0.003 is the robust pick, not a knife-edge
model.floor: x402 settle (Base gas + facilitator) ~$0.001-0.002 per settlement; below $0.002 the rail eats the payment
model.honesty: pricing harvests demand, it does not create it. All revenue figures assume a funnel (Moltbook/RapidAPI/OpenClaw per README) that does not exist yet. No funnel = $0 at any price.
model.valueCheck: S $100-float harvest +$1.32/thread, RENDER $87 +$1.29: a $0.003 call is 0.2% of one harvest; one avoided APE-style trap at $100 saves $100 = 33,333 calls. Price is fractions of value.

monthly.note: operator-billed (not x402 per-call); NOT implemented - needs operator billing + payTo wallet. Ship per-call first.

perCall.x402NetworkNote: Base mainnet (eip155:8453), USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA4ACd9, $0.003 = 3000 units; toll arms when operator sets PAY_TO env on the Vercel project (free funnel while unset)

free.note: free 100 calls/day, no key (matches RapidAPI norm; the funnel, not the product)
